none: PAS NLM-0668F5: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Caesarum Nostrorum issue of 321-324, possibly an irregular copy, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Head diademed right. Reverse description: possibly wreath around legend VOT / [ - ]. Reverse inscription: possibly [CAESARVM NOSTRORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.9mm, Weight: 1.82gms,…
